name: Profiles
short_desc: Your Wizard profile: share your build, look and App Store apps with friends, and try on theirs.
author: Humanity Labs
description: Your Wizard profile with its own Nostr ID. Share your look, your build and your App Store apps with friends or everyone, encrypted through Nostr. Nobody connects to your Wizard; apps you build never show.

form_fields.label: Who can edit this profile (your Tailscale login)
form_fields.hint: Only used to let your own Wizard screens edit the profile. It is never shown or shared; your profile ID is a Nostr ID.
